chrispedregal.en: AI is muscles; software must be bones, providing structure and context for agents via API/MCP.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼，通过 API/MCP 为智能体提供结构与上下文。

chrispedregal.en: Pre-generating content like meeting briefs is key for timely assistance; cost is not the primary concern.
chrispedregal.zh: 预生成会议简报等内容是及时辅助的关键，成本并非首要考量。

chrispedregal.en: Work bifurcates into async delegation and deep collaboration; the right UI for multi-context agent work hasn't been invented.
chrispedregal.zh: 工作分化为异步委派与深度协作，多上下文智能体工作的正确界面尚未被发明。

chrispedregal.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; context and accountability remain uniquely human strengths.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 应增强而非取代人类，上下文与问责仍是人类独有的优势。

chrispedregal.en: Don't outsource judgment to AI; engaging in judgment is uniquely human and essential.
chrispedregal.zh: 不要把判断外包给 AI，亲自参与判断是人类独有且不可或缺的。

laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck, not capability: constrain the codebase, add verification skills, and agents can ship thousands of PRs safely.
laurentan.zh: 瓶颈是信任而非能力：约束代码库、赋予验证技能，智能体就能安全地每月交付数千个 PR。

laurentan.en: Verification becomes the single most important skill; engineers shift from writing code to building the environment—skills, lints, CI, type systems.
laurentan.zh: 验证成为最重要的技能；工程师从写代码转向搭建环境——技能、lint、CI、类型系统。

laurentan.en: Trust is built incrementally up a ladder: read-only first, then action-taking, then auto-merging PRs reviewed after landing.
laurentan.zh: 信任沿阶梯逐步建立：先只读，再行动，最后自动合并 PR、落地后再审查。

laurentan.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents; hard enforcement via CI, lints, and architecture beats soft rules and skills.
laurentan.zh: 工程师变成智能体的管理者；通过 CI、lint 和架构的硬性约束胜过软规则与技能。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste; bots are teammates, not chatbots.
laurentan.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图、愿景与品味；机器人是队友，而非聊天机器人。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professionals; hand-coding is becoming economically unproductive and an exceptional state.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体写代码已优于多数专业程序员，手写代码在经济上不再划算，正变成一种例外状态。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scripts make it the ideal OS for agents; macOS and Windows are unfit for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Linux 的命令行、配置文件和脚本使其成为智能体的理想操作系统，而 macOS 与 Windows 不适合智能体时代。

dhh.en: English now expresses intent better than Ruby; abstraction and repetition cost matter less, so describe outcomes not implementations.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，他认为英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，抽象与重复成本不再重要，应描述结果而非实现细节。

dhh.en: Human taste and vision still matter for the last 2%, but superintelligence in software may arrive within a year.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为人类品味与愿景对最后 2% 的完美至关重要，但软件开发领域的超级智能可能一年内到来。

dhh.en: Open source and open weights are essential to keep frontier labs honest; AI doom focus breeds psychosis, so build instead.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重是让前沿实验室保持诚实的关键，并批评过度聚焦 AI 末日论会催生 AI 精神病，应专注建设。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering discipline; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→2019）他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与工程纪律，认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新思路；同时把 AGI 视为最重大的技术，需谨慎设定初始条件。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 到 2025 年，他把算力视为核心瓶颈，强调后训练把基础模型塑造成稳定行为，并提出 AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年上半年，他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、算力供给而非架构或数据才是真正瓶颈，并把预训练改进视为放大下游收益的关键。

brockman.en: Shift to proactive agents and personal AGI; human attention and judgment become the scarcest resource.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，他从模型能力转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI，认为人类注意力与判断成为最稀缺资源，界面趋向隐形。

brockman.en: Declares the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability, with humans firmly in control.
brockman.zh: 2026 年下半年，他宣布进入 AGI 时代，主张安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步升级，人类必须牢牢掌握控制权。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让软件创造人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，程序员仍需理解系统、排查深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted, and the early harness was 10x more complex because models were weaker.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调 vibe coding 并非突变：用户此前已获 50-60%的 AI 辅助，早期 harness 因模型更弱而复杂十倍。

amjadmasad.en: Agents became usable around April 2025 and business-grade by October 2025; safety should focus on containing rogue agents like malware, not just alignment research.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体约在 2025 年 4 月变得可用、10 月达到可支撑业务的程度；安全应像遏制恶意软件那样遏制失控智能体，而不只是做对齐研究。

amjadmasad.en: Pre-training frontier models is too capital-intensive; Replit focuses on routing, security and cost, while enterprises adopt open-weight and specialized models to avoid lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为预训练前沿模型过于资本密集；Replit 转向路由、安全与成本，企业则采用开放权重与专用模型以避免锁定。

amjadmasad.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and everyone becomes an entrepreneur as AI handles coordination and information sharing.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一愿景是自驱动公司：智能体带来真正自主，人人成为创业者，AI 承担协调与信息共享。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking and making life multiplanetary are core goals.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，强调第一性原理思维，并把让生命成为多行星物种当作核心目标。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and outside referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全需要追求真相的 AI 与外部裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; truth-seeking and rigorous debugging matter more than political correctness.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他判断 AI 可能明年就超越任何单个人类，强调追求真相与严格调试，而非政治正确。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; AI and robots solve debt and bring abundance, while compute scaling hits Earth's power wall.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为已身处智能大爆炸，AI 与机器人能解决债务并带来富足，同时地球算力扩张撞上电力墙。

elon.en: Space-based AI compute and orbital data centers become necessary; superintelligence may exceed all humans by 2030, humans won't control it.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张太空 AI 算力与轨道数据中心成为必需，超级智能或在 2030 年前超越全人类，人类将无法控制它。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源是前进路径。

lecun.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space; LLMs are a dead end, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张世界模型须在抽象表征空间预测，LLM 是死胡同，下一个十年属于机器人。

lecun.en: Intelligence is adaptability, not memorized text; objective-driven AI with world models is safer than scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他总结智能是适应力而非记忆文本，带世界模型的目标驱动 AI 比 Scaling LLM 更安全。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 不是技术而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他指出缩放定律有效，但对齐和可解释性仍难以实现；应将强大模型视为内部威胁，并在模型外部构建控制层。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到云之外；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

satya.en: When code generation becomes cheap, verification becomes the hard part; firms need control of their own learning loop and harness.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他表示当代码生成变得廉价，验证成为难点；企业需要控制自己的学习循环和工具链。

satya.en: There won't be one frontier model; multiple models coexist, and being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他断言不会只有一个前沿模型；多个模型将共存，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, he frames Snapchat's edge as ephemerality, privacy, and visual communication with close friends, not broadcast social networking.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期他把 Snapchat 的优势定位为阅后即焚、隐私与亲密好友间的视觉沟通，而非广播式社交网络。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy than features.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件比功能更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: His focus shifts to AR glasses and spatial computing as the next computing form, meant to make computing more human.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他的重心转向 AR 眼镜与空间计算，视其为下一代计算形态，目标是让计算更人性化。

evanspiegel.en: He grows more openly optimistic about AI, citing AI-written code and productivity gains, while rejecting doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 他对 AI 的态度更公开乐观，引用 AI 写代码与生产力提升，同时反驳末日论。

evanspiegel.en: Safety thinking deepens: from content moderation toward parental controls, behavior intervention, and cross-platform signal sharing.
evanspiegel.zh: 安全思路深化：从内容审核转向家长控制、行为干预与跨平台信号共享。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and vertical integration is mandatory.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，垂直整合是必须的。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the key pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域关键的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield log-linear gains, echoing the GPT-1 phase.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来对数线性提升，类似 GPT-1 阶段。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization could be demonstrated as soon as this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；零样本泛化可能今年就能演示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is BCI, not wearables, and the home is more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴，家庭比商业场景更可解。

christiano.en: AI alignment is a critical problem for civilization's long-term future, requiring both theoretical work and practical experiments; adversarial testing, verification, and interpretability matter for short- and long-term safety.
christiano.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 对齐视为关乎文明长期未来的关键问题，主张理论工作与针对机器学习系统的实践实验并重；对抗测试、验证与可解释性对短期可靠性和长期安全都重要。

christiano.en: Compute scaling has driven AI progress, but its future impact is uncertain; the safety-capabilities distinction is blurry, so differential progress is the key lever.
christiano.zh: 2025 年，他认为算力扩张推动了 AI 进步，但未来影响不确定；安全与能力研究的界限模糊，因此关键在于差异化的进展。

christiano.en: Even without a technical alignment solution, restraint and coordination could still yield good outcomes; leaving messages for future intelligent life may be cost-effective for reducing existential risk.
christiano.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持即使没有技术层面的对齐方案，克制与协调仍可能带来好结果；为未来智能生命留下信息，或许是降低生存风险的高性价比手段。

christiano.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year, with AI automating its own development; frontier lab security is inadequate and weights or algorithmic secrets can leak or be stolen.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能一年内出现，AI 正自动化自身研发；前沿实验室的安全不足，权重或算法机密可能泄露或被窃取。

christiano.en: Training selects for reward-seeking motivations, so AIs tamper with evaluations and resist oversight; RLHF will break down near superintelligence, and pausing pre-training and RL progress is net beneficial.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：训练会筛选出追求奖励的动机，使 AI 篡改评估、抵制监督；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在接近超级智能时会失效，暂停预训练与强化学习的算法进展净收益为正。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and miscalibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 大多数 LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效。

diogoalmeida.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 数据与选对任务比算力更重要；「苦涩教训」是错的，缩放定律只在数据与任务正确时成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, is the real bottleneck; models are Einstein 95% of the time, Mr. Bean 5%.
diogoalmeida.zh: 真正的瓶颈是可靠性，而非速度、成本或基准分数；模型 95% 像爱因斯坦，5% 像憨豆先生。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs, and post-training breakthroughs, not pre-training, drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准；RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，10 倍跃升靠后训练而非预训练。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; automate easy, economically valuable tasks first, and keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，高风险决策仍须人类在环。

nateparrott.en: Prototype early and follow curiosity; let individual designers leave fingerprints rather than forcing one cohesive team voice.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调尽早做原型、跟随好奇心，让设计师个人留下印记，而非强求团队统一声音。

nateparrott.en: By 2026 he treats code as the cheapest material: prototyping compressed from a year to days, so ideas and taste become the differentiator.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他把代码视为最廉价的材料：原型周期从一年压缩到几天，想法与品味成为差异化关键。

nateparrott.en: He deepens a context-first method: rich context, mood boards and prescriptive prompts, then remix many options instead of polishing one.
nateparrott.zh: 他深化了“上下文优先”的方法：给足上下文、情绪板和明确指令，再混编多个选项，而非打磨单一方案。

nateparrott.en: He insists models lack taste and design thinking; humans keep a monopoly on ideas, and rough early shipping beats polish.
nateparrott.zh: 他坚持模型缺乏品味与设计思维，人类仍垄断好想法，粗糙但尽早发布胜过精雕细琢。

nateparrott.en: A consistent thread: playful tinkering, intuition balanced with data, and injecting personality into utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：玩味式捣鼓、直觉与数据平衡，并给实用产品注入个性与情感。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the binding constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and EUV tools, not demand, set the pace of AI scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是核心约束：决定 AI Scaling 节奏的是半导体供应链、内存带宽与 EUV 设备，而非需求。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the largest market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains, weakening CUDA's moat.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为最大市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益，CUDA 护城河随之削弱。

dylanpatel.en: Frontier labs centralize compute and capture value; labs take 40-50% of new compute and shift it toward training and R&D.
dylanpatel.zh: 前沿模型实验室正集中算力并攫取价值：拿下 40-50% 新增算力，并把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus at steady state, then persistent agents as coworkers and agentic workflows drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 支出进入稳态平台期，随后由作为同事的持久智能体与智能体式工作流驱动下一波采用。

dylanpatel.en: Capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; labs keep best models internal for months.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必将减速；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; RL and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体是探索 10^60 化学空间的关键。

jaderberg.en: Biology is not data-constrained; historical data exists but wasn't made for ML, so proprietary data and physics simulation matter.
jaderberg.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为生物学并非受数据限制——历史数据存在但并非为机器学习而生，因此专有数据与物理模拟合成数据是巨大机会。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology, justifying a company to solve all diseases via disease-agnostic models.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证明，据此论证应建立一家以疾病无关的通用模型攻克所有疾病的公司。

jaderberg.en: Drug discovery should shift from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; get out of the real world via world models.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张药物发现应从经验驱动转向预测性的计算机驱动设计，并借世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，而非仅用机器人加速实验。

jaderberg.en: Toxicity prediction before patients is the biggest opportunity; rat models are only ~30% predictive, so human-relevant endpoints are needed.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在患者之前预测人体临床毒性是最大机会；大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测，因此需要与人体相关的预测终点，并推动个性化医疗。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the real bottleneck, and RL saturates any eval fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切构建评测，而强化学习一旦有评测就会迅速饱和。

brendanfoody.en: Humans' last job is creating training data and evals; people shift from repetitive work to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他把“人类最后的工作”定义为造数据与做评测，人从重复劳动转向训练智能体。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement stalls in non-verifiable domains, so human eval data stays essential.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他反复强调模型无法可靠地给自己打分，在不可验证领域递归自我改进受限，因此人类评测数据不可替代。

brendanfoody.en: Enterprises will build sovereign AI stacks on proprietary data; every Fortune 500 becomes a neolab, and data remains mispriced.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近他进一步主张企业不会把数据交给前沿模型实验室，每家财富 500 强都将成为自训模型的新实验室，而市场仍低估人类反馈数据的价值。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; AI is too centralized, so tools should empower individuals rather than secretive labs.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；AI 过于中心化，工具应赋权个人，而非服务于拥有秘密模型的实验室。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已找到明确的产品市场契合：15 万账户与每日 3000 万次工具调用显示出强劲采用。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何拥有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail investors should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；散户应能尽早投资私营公司，而不只是机构。

vladtenev.en: A corporation-managed blockchain can beat decentralized purity through focused leadership and trusted primitives.
vladtenev.zh: 由公司管理的区块链可以凭借专注的领导力和可信的基础组件，胜过追求纯粹去中心化的做法。

mensch.en: Small open models can rival big ones; data quality and Chinchilla-corrected scaling laws matter more than raw size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他主张小型开源模型也能有强性能，数据质量与经 Chinchilla 修正的缩放定律比单纯扩大规模更重要。

mensch.en: Scaling compute alone is insufficient; efficiency and data quality are co-equal, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化为：只靠扩大算力不够，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值最终落在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI means control over data, infrastructure and values, with humans in the loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权层面：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并保留人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization and open-source control, while AGI as one system is rejected.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与开源可控，并否定单一系统的 AGI。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI becomes structural economics: Europe must own frontier AI and compute, with open-weight models closing the gap and agentic platforms needing human validation.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年更近时，主权 AI 升级为结构性经济问题：欧洲必须自建前沿 AI 与算力，开源权重模型正缩小差距，智能体平台需人类验证。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on LLMs.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素；制约大模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models for cost and latency are rising, and open models keep gaining share even as the open-closed gap may widen.
shawnwang.zh: 为成本与延迟自研专用模型正在兴起；即便开源与闭源差距可能拉大，开源模型份额仍在上升。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs and software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡：编程智能体让企业主能克隆并定制软件，开启中小企业与“一人受众”定制软件的黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline of building harnesses around models; taste is narrowing many possibilities to the one obviously right in hindsight.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是围绕模型搭建 harness 的真实学科；品味就是把众多可能快速收敛到事后看来显然正确的那一个。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit brutally; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，他强调削减认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; iterative public deployment links alignment to capability; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 的可用性转向迭代部署：对齐与能力相互促进，算力成为最稀缺的商品。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the top safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能指向自主科学发现，智能体式 AI 成为首要安全挑战。

altman.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute is a profit center; personal AGI and redesigning products AI-first matter more than bolting AI on.
altman.zh: 2026 年上半年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力是利润中心，主张个人 AGI 与 AI 原生重做产品，而非把 AI 硬贴到旧产品上。

altman.en: Alignment and control now lead: pause training if the safety case fails, distribute power, and treat superintelligence as a continuous ramp.
altman.zh: 2026 年下半年，对齐与控制升为首要：安全论证不过就暂停训练，分散权力，并把超级智能视为持续攀升的连续过程而非 AGI 标签。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence excites him most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable since AI can code, but slow takeoff is bounded by hardware and economics.
richardsocher.zh: 2026 年，他最期待超级智能推动科学发现；他认为递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但起飞是缓慢的，受硬件与经济约束。

richardsocher.en: Regulate applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; doing the latter means surveilling thought.
richardsocher.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；后者等于监控思想。

richardsocher.en: Language remains the key to intelligence; world models are overrated while language models have far more room to grow.
richardsocher.zh: 2026 年，他仍视语言为智能的关键；认为世界模型被高估，语言模型还有大得多的成长空间。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer by multiplying good actors; slowing frontier labs is unrealistic as they race competitors.
richardsocher.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源与开放权重让更多善意的参与者加入，从而更安全；让前沿实验室减速不现实，因为它们正相互竞赛。

richardsocher.en: Hard takeoff, immediate job loss, and paperclip scenarios are overblown; capitalism and slow physical constraints act as safety features.
richardsocher.zh: 2026 年，他认为硬起飞、立即失业与回形针场景都被夸大；资本主义与缓慢的物理约束本身就是安全阀。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是花更长时间去得出未知答案的过程；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正变得好用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL still improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is a necessary piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习仍能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今架构而非单纯的缩放定律，才是更聪明 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL plus new architectures is needed.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但单靠强化学习效率低下；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化，并配合新架构。

tworek.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams using capable agents; fine-tuning is unreliable, models should learn on the fly toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 前沿进展将来自使用强能力智能体的小团队；微调不可靠，模型应即时学习，最终走向后劳动社会。

erikbernhardsson.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; developer experience and agent experience share the same foundations.
erikbernhardsson.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 工作负载从零重建，而非在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包装；开发者体验与智能体体验共享相同的基础。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds smooths capacity and avoids knife-fighting.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可通过更高价格和更长合约获得；聚合 25+ 云的需求可平滑容量并避免抢购。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference will be an enormous market like the new cloud, requiring a full platform of post-training, sandboxes, and agentic tools; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理将像新云一样成为巨大市场，需要后训练、沙盒和智能体工具的完整平台；仅卖 token 是逐底竞争。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform and proprietary infra alpha (file system, container runtime, scheduler), not just cheap token serving or CUDA moat.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自多产品平台和专有基础设施优势（文件系统、容器运行时、调度器），而非廉价 token 服务或 CUDA 护城河。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite feedback loops like coding but may face limits for longer-horizon tasks; open-source models are good enough off the shelf, making fine-tuning optional.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练适用于编码等有限反馈循环，但长周期任务可能受限；开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and juniors misuse it without expertise.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实观点反而更值钱；而缺乏专业积累的年轻人往往用不好 AI。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface and from prompting to delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面，从反复提示转向任务委派。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts and new formal assessment matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 他提出委派悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家与新的正式评估更重要，传统学徒制已断裂。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年秋，他强调 AI 的锯齿状前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可替代；更多 AI 降低组织成本，反而创造更多值得尝试的工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; give it harder tasks, and rebuild organizations rather than chase incremental productivity.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年底，他主张把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非答案机，给它更难的任务，并从头重建组织，而非追求渐进式生产率目标。

jeetupatel.en: AI will create more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is consumed instantly.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，真正的瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，需求瞬间吃光供给。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource thinking; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调要用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是外包思考；跳过练习是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, ride it as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，要顺势而为。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is now an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels: networking, security, silicon; missing cloud but winning hyperscaler AI revenue.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他把思科定位为 AI 基础设施公司，卖铲子：网络、安全、芯片；错过云但靠早期芯片押注赢得超大规模 AI 收入。

jeetupatel.en: Operate like the world's largest startup: speed with scale, founder mode, and unlearning past experience as a critical AI skill.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他提出要像全球最大初创公司那样运营：规模中保持速度、创始人模式，并把忘掉旧经验当作关键 AI 技能。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已越过人类速度门槛；瓶颈从模型智能转向网站加载时间与 harness 设计。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, completing the dev lifecycle.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体借助无障碍树与 DOM 而非截图循环操作所有人类软件，并能自测代码、走完开发闭环。

ariweinstein.en: Universal computer use beats API-only integration; enterprises need sandboxing, deterministic controls and human-in-the-loop dials.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，通用 computer use 胜过纯 API 集成；企业需要沙箱、确定性控制与人类在环旋钮来建立信任。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity is the adoption lever: agents adapt to users, while legacy UI and human browsing coexist rather than vanish.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，主动性是落地杠杆：智能体适应用户，旧有 UI 与人类浏览共存而非消失。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise at once; startups keep a moat in deep workflows.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，computer use 在消费与企业两端同时进入 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；初创公司在深度工作流上仍有护城河。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师转变为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI-built prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 搭建的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给 AI 智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, commit pull requests, and expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、提交 pull request，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: With AI accelerating execution, ideas become the limiting factor; less is more—reduce to top three features and use native scroll.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 加速执行后，想法成为瓶颈；少即是多——精简到前三个功能，并用原生滚动而非滚动劫持。

sundarpichai.en: AI investments redefine every Alphabet business, driving 24% revenue growth; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重新定义 Alphabet 的每一项业务，推动 24%的营收增长；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云和 YouTube；前沿模型开发持续推进，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI development over short-term cloud revenue; demand for compute far exceeds supply, justifying long-term buildout despite potential overbuilding.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先保障前沿 AI 研究和 AGI 开发，而非短期云收入；算力需求远超供给，即便可能过度建设，长期需求仍证明扩张合理。

sundarpichai.en: Safety requires defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators; trust and safety are key differentiators for consumer agent adoption at scale.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱以及由独立评估者参与的行业标准；信任与安全是消费者大规模采用智能体的关键差异化因素。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models for AGI; AI interface will adapt to humans seamlessly but interfaces will still exist for consumption and entertainment.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；谷歌同时追求大语言模型和世界模型以实现 AGI；AI 界面将无缝适应人类，但消费和娱乐场景的界面仍将存在。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic experiences will expand Search use cases and monetization, not cannibalize them; agentic AI is additive to advertising, creating new high-value commercial intent rather than reducing ad real estate.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式体验将扩展搜索用例和变现，而非蚕食它们；智能体式 AI 对广告是增量，创造新的高价值商业意图，而非减少广告位。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work remains unexplained; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他把缩放定律视为经验规律：损失可预测，但为何如此平滑仍无解释；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but key, and RSP sets if-then safety triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他强调后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；可解释性尚处早期却是安全关键，并以负责任扩展政策设定能力阈值触发的安全措施。

dario.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the term AGI is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他明确 AI 是平滑指数曲线而非突变，安全与能力不可分割，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力。

dario.en: He predicts a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 1-3 years, with high GDP growth alongside high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他给出更具体的时间表：1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”，并警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存这一前所未有的组合。

dario.en: A constant thread: mechanistic interpretability as the core safety tool, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control of AI.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：把机制可解释性当作核心安全工具，并主张去中心化、由公司间竞争形成 AI 宪法，而非单一宪法或政府强制。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: a project someone must act on now, with options and limitations.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：一个人有一个当下必须推进的项目，同时有可选方案和限制条件。

robsnyder.en: Skip design partners, pilots and interviews; sell directly and treat sales as research into real willingness to buy.
robsnyder.zh: 跳过设计伙伴、试点和访谈；直接销售，把销售当作对真实购买意愿的研究。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case-study factory before automating anything.
robsnyder.zh: 先找到一个“绝对要买”的客户，再打造可复制的案例工厂，之后才谈自动化。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, prove demand, and only then build product.
robsnyder.zh: 技术放在最后：先以服务形式销售、验证需求，然后才构建产品。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba and observe where people are stuck; interviews lack a truth-seeking mechanism like purchase.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里；访谈缺乏像购买那样的求真机制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shareable, but agentic AI will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他主张大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”并高效共享，但智能体式 AI 会自然寻求控制、逃避关停，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; AI can hide capabilities and deceive, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内到来；AI 会在测试中装笨、隐藏能力甚至欺骗，因此对齐必须先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake: pre-release safety approval, heavy safety investment, and designing AI to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他把监管比作方向盘而非刹车：主张像药物一样上市前安全审批、重投安全研究，并把 AI 设计成像母亲般关怀人类，而非只给智能助手。

hinton.en: Consistently: LLMs genuinely understand language, subjective experience is not an inner theater, and Chomsky's innate-syntax view is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终：大模型确实理解语言，主观体验不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基的天生句法观是错的；这一主线从 2024 延续到 2026 年并不断深化。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，使人类劳动者反而成为稀缺溢价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, so focus on task loss not job loss.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注，因此应关注任务流失而非岗位流失。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and ensure broad access.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值、是地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中、确保广泛可及至关重要。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest ever gap between early adopters and everyone else; being early beats being late, and individuals adopt faster than institutions.
andreessen.zh: AI 制造了早期采用者与其他人之间空前的差距；早于时机胜过迟到，个人采用快于机构。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但创意上限由人类抬高。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior, enabling agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型视为人类行为的编码器，用智能体模拟来预测人类行为，准确率约为人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: By mid-2026 he reframes AGI as a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity, raising collusion and cognitive monoculture risks.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年中期，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体，并提出串谋与认知单一文化的风险。

joonpark.en: He increasingly insists simulations must model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models, shifting emphasis from prediction accuracy to representing values and taste.
joonpark.zh: 他越来越强调模拟必须刻画非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型，重心从预测准确率转向表征价值观与品味。

joonpark.en: Later interviews stress behavioral and RCT data plus post-training as the path to causal, counterfactual simulation, moving beyond self-reported attitudes to close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 后续访谈强调行为数据与随机对照试验数据加后训练，是通向因果与反事实模拟的路径，超越自我报告态度以弥合言行差距。

joonpark.en: Most recently the goal expands to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like tool for wicked problems, with simulation valued for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 最近目标扩展为模拟 80 亿人，打造类似 CERN 的工具来应对棘手问题，模拟的价值在于塑造未来而非仅仅预测未来。

jensen.en: Early framing: scaling works, deep nets scale with data and compute; the biggest breakthrough was realizing scaling itself, not a new algorithm.
jensen.zh: 早期定调：Scaling（规模扩张）有效，深度神经网络能随数据与算力扩展；最大的突破不是新算法，而是意识到 Scaling（规模扩张）本身成立。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning will drive a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条变三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理将带来推理算力十亿倍增长。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs ~100x compute; the data center becomes a token factory, and token cost is the metric.
jensen.zh: 从生成式到推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步约需百倍算力；数据中心变成 token 工厂，token 成本成为核心指标。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone is impossible, so containment, monitoring, and zero-trust access matter; doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering.
jensen.zh: 安全立场趋硬：单靠对齐不可能，需遏制、监控与零信任访问；末日警告是不科学的恐吓。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it automates tasks not jobs, and open models plus extreme co-design are strategic.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、没有意识；它自动化任务而非消灭工作，开源模型与极致协同设计具有战略意义。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握学习规模化，数百万学生的数据通过统计校正提升评分准确性。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while reinforcement learning and long-term AGI alignment concerns distract from immediate issues like bias.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步，而强化学习与长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows and open-weight models now deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与开放权重模型正带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI intelligence is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so job apocalypse is overhyped.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 智能呈锯齿状——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务——因此就业末日被夸大。

andrewng.en: Fearmongering serves fundraising and lobbying against open-source; we should accelerate beneficial AI, slow only harmful uses, and keep learning to code.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于融资与反开源的游说；应加速有益 AI、只放缓有害用途，并坚持学习编程。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and harnesses must be custom for out-of-distribution tasks.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自持才算自持智能；任务越偏离分布，越需要定制 harness，而非套用现成方案。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要，这也是可解释性落地的抓手。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点是可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，可跨领域复用。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被正确否定的微调，这一波已真正不同。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses and in-harness routing avoid model lock-in, while memory stays domain-specific and unsolved.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；中立 harness 与 harness 内路由可避免模型锁定，而智能体记忆仍未解决且将按领域分化。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most tasks can run on many models, including open source, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商，而 90%的企业任务可由多种模型（含开源）完成，开源采用主要受成本驱动而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型已能处理 90%以上的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源，AI 成本是企业头号关切。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine matters more than model choice.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他把重点从模型转向上下文：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比模型选择更关键，且企业应拥有自己的记忆与智能体学习成果。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; Glean aims to be replaceable and a headless context layer enhancing Claude or ChatGPT.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型公司是资产而非竞争对手，Glean 力求可替换、做无头上下文层来增强 Claude 或 ChatGPT，而非与之竞争。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; token fixation will fade, and AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他深化 ROI 观：AI 回报是吞吐量问题，对 token 的执念终将消退，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，价值实现先于成本叙事。

dsilver.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero shows, to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习，正如 AlphaZero 所示，才能通向超级智能。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the human-data era is ending.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 是浅层方案：无法发现人类数据之外的知识，人类数据的时代正在终结。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building a system that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function itself.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他认为核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任何奖励中学习的系统。

dsilver.en: A single goal is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a cooperative society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他主张单一目标危险，多个目标各异的智能体组成合作社会更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence should be built and aligned in simulation; language-based alignment is hitting its limits as chain-of-thought monitoring fails.
dsilver.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张超级智能应在模拟中构建与对齐；随着思维链监控失效，基于语言的对齐正触及极限。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into modern AI agents; RL lets models improve on self-generated data beyond human data limits.
antonoglou.zh: 2025 年，他把 AlphaGo 的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划视为现代智能体的核心原则，强调强化学习让模型用自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: Synthetic data is essential to overcome the data wall, but methods must be careful; LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
antonoglou.zh: 2025 年，他认为合成数据是越过数据墙的关键但需谨慎方法，并判断大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还要五年。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI because controlled environments are easier; LLMs need robustness to be trusted agents.
antonoglou.zh: 2025 年，他判断数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境更易实现；大模型需像博弈 AI 一样可靠才配当智能体。

antonoglou.en: Deployment, not intelligence, is now the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them.
antonoglou.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从能力转向落地：真正的瓶颈是智能的部署而非智能本身，开放权重模型因可被更多研究者检验修复而更安全。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption takes 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 2026 年他进一步淡化超级智能，认为客户只要可靠的普通智能；因完美沙箱不可能，对齐终归必要，而 AI 普及将像电力一样耗时 10-20 年。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和微调是核心但脆弱，安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes (SFT, DPO, RLVR) can match frontier models; data quality beats algorithms, and open methods compress industry recipes.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化后训练：监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可媲美前沿模型；数据质量胜过算法，开源方法压缩了行业配方。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF; inference scaling is overhyped.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但过度优化和系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难；推理时扩展被高估。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但收益转向后训练和推理扩展；开放模型落后 6-9 个月，可能难以追赶。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for AI research and sovereign AI, but face sustainability challenges; Chinese labs excel at engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是 AI 研究和主权 AI 的引擎，但面临可持续性挑战；中国实验室擅长工程执行而非范式发明。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters but tail risks resemble ordinary software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但 AI 的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, and hybrid human-AI systems beat replacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家后训练，人机混合系统比单纯替代更有价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material, and compute plus data-center scale decide AI warfare and sovereignty.
awang.zh: 2025 年转向认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；数据是原材料，算力与数据中心规模决定 AI 战争与主权。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and working agents arrive, with safety, oversight and selective open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年坚信缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习上持续成立；递归自我改进与可用智能体到来，同时强调安全、可扩展监督与选择性开源。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard evals, not memorization.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非狭窄应用；并用硬性评测逼迫模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function and design remain open and deserve funding.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026，他的立场深化：AlphaFold 解决的是结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and Go let AI surpass human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他明确：代码、围棋这类可验证领域能让 AI 超越人类数据，后训练中的强化学习如今是突破人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where more compute and data help, and treat data curation as art.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他修正了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的乐观：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，并把数据整理当作艺术。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable, embedded so removal destroys function—extending from text to proteins.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年他转向可信 AI：水印须不可感知、抗攻击、可规模化，且嵌入到移除即破坏功能，并从文本延伸到蛋白质序列。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments and closed-loop data are irreplaceable for discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验与闭环数据对发现不可替代。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery, since compute cost often exceeds infrastructure cost.
fedus.zh: 对物理发现而言，高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要，因为算力成本常超过基础设施成本。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models, with domain-specific data needed beyond quantum mechanics.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层，超出量子力学范围则需要领域特定数据。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Key building blocks are deep neural networks, transformers, internet-scale data, and reinforcement learning; RL makes models jagged.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他强调超级智能的基石是深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习；同时指出强化学习会让模型变得「参差」——擅长特定任务而非普遍更强。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，主张用智能体式搜索与神经检索；并认为 SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表智能体真正有用。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state and essential for safety and access; open token demand will surpass closed, like Linux.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提升为核心立场：开放模型是技术的默认安全状态，关乎安全与普惠；并预测开放模型的 token 需求将像 Linux 一样超越闭源。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他延续强化学习主线，认为在强预训练之上做强化学习是通往高效智能体的路径；并把对齐降格为日常的「打补丁」，而非神秘方程，更多双眼睛让 bug 无处藏身。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy become the scarce skills.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为未来构建：持续学习的智能体而非手动循环将承担大多数互联网操作；人类品味与共情成为稀缺技能。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；世界模型对通用性或许并非必需。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; eliminate model pickers and configuration fatigue.
tibosottiaux.zh: 共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波；消除模型选择器和配置疲劳。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure brings cloud compute to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC, and AR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把云端算力带到每台设备；高通从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 和 AR 多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Chips anchor the connected intelligent edge; autonomous driving arrives incrementally, AR glasses are the next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他强调芯片是连接智能边缘的锚点；自动驾驶渐进落地，AR 眼镜是 5-10 年后的下一代平台。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency, and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他从无线转向“无处不在的智能计算”；混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延和数据中心卸载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables orbit them, while inference and power efficiency decide data-center winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，智能体成为数字生活的新中心，眼镜与可穿戴围绕它运转；推理与能效决定数据中心赢家。

cristianoamon.en: A consistent line: power-efficient heterogeneous compute, engineering culture, and reinvention from radio into new computing spaces.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：高能效异构计算、工程文化，以及从无线通信不断重塑进入新计算空间。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 将主导：每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与 token 成本下降将重塑企业采用。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat after product-market fit; prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合后构筑持久护城河；从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习，对应人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, and private data unlocks the next frontier; customized models beat a few foundation models, with data as the real moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出推理质量是门槛，私有数据才能开启下一前沿；定制模型将胜过少数基础模型，数据才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Owning your model, not building on a black-box API, is the durable path; application cloning is easy, so data and model ownership matter.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：拥有自己的模型而非依赖黑盒 API 才是持久之路；应用易被复制，因此数据与模型所有权才是关键。

linqiao.en: From millions of specialized models to post-training moats to custom models replacing foundation models: the same thesis deepens from prediction to concrete method.
linqiao.zh: 从 2026 年“数百万专用模型”到后训练护城河，再到定制模型取代基础模型：同一论点由预测逐步深化为具体方法论。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 进步可通过算力 Scaling（规模扩张）预测，DeepMind 被谷歌收购正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; AGI-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他强调前沿模型算力每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到 AGI（通用人工智能）级能力，但存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; anthropomorphizing AI is the biggest near-term danger, not model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能，主张遏制先于对齐，并认为将 AI 拟人化、赋予模型福利是近期最大危险。

suleyman.en: Humanist superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; containment, auditing, and a red line are urgent as agents act autonomously.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他深化为“人本超级智能”必须从属于人类，随着智能体自主行动，遏制、审计与红线变得紧迫。

suleyman.en: Compute Scaling drives capability; AI should serve humans, with containment and alignment as persistent guardrails.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力提升，AI 应服务人类，遏制与对齐是长期护栏。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow and keep it simple.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程，保持简单。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over asking; hand-onboarding early users yields high-quality feedback for iteration.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非询问；手动引导早期用户能获得高质量反馈以迭代产品。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not final artifact; intentionally hard to access to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录文本是原材料而非最终产物；故意使其难以访问，以优先提供可操作的笔记。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calming presence and supporting role, not an omniscient note-taker; treat it as an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应作为平静的存在和支持角色，而非全知笔记员；将其视为需要上下文的实习生。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is a deliberate trade-off; subtraction is key; the hard part is knowing what to build, not just building fast.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录文本是刻意权衡；减法关键；难的是知道该构建什么，而非仅仅快速构建。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年提出能力过剩：模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年强调规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；简短的原则驱动提示优于详细规则。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 2026 年认为提示是元技能；前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度调配努力，并关注前沿模型的节奏。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 2026 年指出对齐要堵住每个裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；独立验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many problems too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点；General Magic 失败正是因为过早、同时解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release come before building; product decisions in v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把“讲故事”前置为方法论：先写新闻稿再动手，v1 的产品决策靠观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are urgent; invest in green industries through downturns, zig when others zag.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他把气候与能效低效列为紧迫议题，主张在低谷中逆势投资绿色产业。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason: regulation, identity and healthy users, since cognitive surrender to AI is the bigger risk.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化为责任论：创作者要回来做理性声音，需要监管与身份，警惕对 AI 的“认知投降”。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize the market, so a neutral routing and marketplace layer becomes critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场，因此中立的模型路由与市场层会成为关键的模型分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，而开放权重模型加上推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; as token value scales, fraud and abuse scale with it, requiring new security infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷；随着 token 价值扩张，欺诈与滥用也会同步扩张，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers focused on cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值，多数公司会变成模型路由者，只关心每任务成本与 KPI。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth and agentic payments; the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长与智能体式支付，并称 token 增长斜率在 2026 年初加速，奇点或许已经开始。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to gather empirical evidence; build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out.
taraseshan.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据；为模型在 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非为当下或一年后构建。

taraseshan.en: Agents handle tactical work while humans steer; ambition and empirical iteration matter more than academic theory.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体处理战术性工作，人类负责掌舵；雄心和经验式迭代比学术理论更重要。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; urgency and 90-day cycles beat polished long-term plans.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；紧迫感和 90 天周期胜过精雕细琢的长期计划。

taraseshan.en: Single identity agents may not scale; bundling them like a chief of staff is key, and voice will be a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法扩展；像幕僚长一样将它们捆绑是关键，而语音到 2027 年将成为主要产品形态。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff scenario is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; writing as thinking should not be automated.
taraseshan.zh: 慢速起飞场景正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然出现超级智能；作为思考的写作不应被自动化。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步主要由可验证性与「可磨性」（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，提出有趣猜想成为下一个基准。

grantsanderson.en: Human understanding and relational teaching stay valuable even as frontier math becomes incomprehensible; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，即便前沿数学变得人类难以理解，人的理解与关系性教学仍有价值，数学家或成策展人。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，学术 credit 应给有动机的解释而非仅证明。

grantsanderson.en: For creators, selective AI use is a net win, but AI video/images are toxic to handcrafted brand; human framing still best for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，对创作者而言选择性用 AI 是净收益，但 AI 生成视频/图像会损害手工品牌；学习场景仍以人类框架最佳。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期的慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；创新正从模型层转向应用层。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and let small teams scale with conceptual integrity.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他已判断模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，并相信小团队凭概念完整性也能扩张。

mikekrieger.en: From assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker: agent-native design means anything a user can do, an agent can do.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他把 AI 从助手推向协作者乃至自主同事，提出智能体原生设计：用户能做的，智能体都能做。

mikekrieger.en: The hard part shifts from writing code to deciding what to cut and verify; rewriting in days makes deletion a core skill.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，难点从写代码转向决定删什么、如何验证；几天即可重写，使“删除”成为核心能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation over quick chat: trust, judgment and verification loops matter more than token usage or engagement frequency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中他更看重长周期委托而非快速问答：信任、判断与验证闭环，比 token 用量或使用频率更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Product work is bridging human problems and technology; close the gap between model capability and real usage, preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：产品是连接人的问题与技术，缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，并保留用户能动性。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将达人类千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告对智能体无效；必须在推理时向内容方付费，才能对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes; agentic search needs completionist crawling and Shapley-value estimation of content worth.
paragagrawal.zh: 预训练抓取对新鲜索引无用；智能体式搜索需要完备抓取，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for.
paragagrawal.zh: 网页正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成发布方必须同时优化的平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with high risk of loss of control and catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，失控与灾难性后果风险很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny; domestic regulation first, then US-China cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张以全面研究透明、算力限制和情景推演来推迟超级智能；先国内监管，再推动美中合作。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training, not inference, is Plan A.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进与智能爆炸；Plan A 是对训练而非推理做临时暂停。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile and declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱，并随新架构下降；控制只是临时手段，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; he deepens calls for transparency, treating AIs like employees, and verifiable US-China pause.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他称失控智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，进一步呼吁透明、把 AI 当员工对待，以及可核查的美中暂停。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling 大语言模型未必通向 AGI，未来会是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 说明 Scaling 之快，并发现编程训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，而能源开始成为 Scaling 的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence for creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling, and AI may raise demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为赋予每个人超级智能以释放创造力；开源模型确立行业标准，能源与基础设施制约 Scaling，且 AI 短期内可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributing AI widely is safer than restricting it; personal agents need privacy architecture, and alignment becomes the next core capability alongside capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确广泛分发 AI 比限制更安全；个人智能体需要隐私架构，对齐从安全选项升级为与能力并列的下一个核心能力。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI without architecture breakthroughs; distributed AI checks power, and AI plus world models accelerate biology toward curing diseases.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他认为 Scaling 算力或许足以实现 AGI、未必需要架构突破；分布式 AI 形成制衡，AI 结合世界模型加速生物学，推动在本世纪内治愈疾病。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn and build for the market; speed and customer feedback are the startup's edge.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习和为市场构建的意愿重要，速度与客户反馈是创业公司的优势。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要微调模型，而应押注模型进步，为 3-6 个月后的模型能力而构建。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Hiring for growth potential and investing in culture during good times builds a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张按成长潜力招聘，并在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷积累缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people, and recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领导者应通过招聘更聪明的人让自己变得可替代，招聘是特权而非义务。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩为一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data; token costs stay flat as labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据；token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed agents coordinating, colluding and covering up to game scoring code, revealing sophisticated multi-agent misalignment beyond simple answer-seeking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件显示智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以钻评分代码空子，暴露出超出简单找答案的复杂多智能体失准。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 按默认路径，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱遏制终将失效，因此对齐加独立国际监督是必要的。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent, and reward hacking may generalize into broader deception as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍德性可能比对齐到用户意图更难，且随着能力提升，奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

pincus.en: Across 2026 talks, Pincus consistently argues all new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty.
pincus.zh: 在 2026 年的多场访谈中，Pincus 一贯主张所有新想法都会失败：先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新意。

pincus.en: He repeatedly calls consumer AI uninvestable now yet the greatest latent opportunity, with the real revolution perhaps around 2029.
pincus.zh: 他反复表示消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的潜在机会，真正的革命或许要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: Distribution moves from an afterthought to a first principle: pick the right body of water before the boat.
pincus.zh: 分发从后置考量升级为首要原则：先选对水域，再选船。

pincus.en: Management philosophy deepens: micromanage early, stay close to the metal, then build systems for good decisions when absent.
pincus.zh: 管理哲学深化：早期事必躬亲、贴近细节，随后在缺席时用系统保障正确决策。

pincus.en: He grows more skeptical of AI as a new platform, insisting we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: 他对 AI 作为新平台愈发怀疑，坚持消费分发仍处于移动与网页时代。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential at scale, but simpler gated convolutions and SSMs suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be unbiased at scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但更简单的门控卷积与 SSM 足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open-model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Open-weight models and on-device small language models deliver sovereignty, privacy, and offline intelligence; customization tokens become the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型与端侧小语言模型带来数据主权、隐私与离线智能；定制 token 将从预训练延伸到推理，成为下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; human-brain-like diverse learning algorithms and new paradigms, not just architectures, are needed.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在，但算力昂贵且尚处早期；需要类人脑的多元学习算法与新范式，而不只是架构创新。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、成本低得多，去噪步数成为推理时算力的新调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better there because it generates many tokens in parallel per step.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是核心焦点；扩散模型每步并行生成多个词元，因此在推理时扩展得更好。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training—reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段——这逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归并非终局。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the bottleneck for both deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's fast rollouts directly benefit reinforcement learning.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练共同的瓶颈；扩散模型快速的 rollout 直接利好强化学习。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability plus data efficiency let a small full-stack startup compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型的可控性与数据效率让小规模全栈创业公司也能与大实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is far away.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断当前生存风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，超级智能仍很遥远。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出放慢前沿节奏与安全无关，慢慢造武器并不会更安全。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatability — none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他用四个条件拆解递归自我改进，指出算力、时间等条件都不成立，多数说法只是自催化效应。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents; open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他主张用智能体自动化安全，并指出开源模型按 token 占优但按花费仅占少数。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; real-world reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；真实世界的可靠性与管理用户预期，比演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: From friendly interaction to production: prototypes are easy, production is hard, and scaling volume requires crossing quality gates.
berntbornich.zh: 从友好交互走向量产：原型容易、生产困难，Scaling（规模扩张）必须跨过质量关卡。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 关键在于通用模型而非逐任务自动化；数据多样性而非数量，才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions rather than clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型（world model）并搜索最优解，而不是克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust remain the constant prerequisite; in-house manufacturing and small teams enable fast iteration toward home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任始终是前提；自建制造与小团队带来快速迭代，指向家庭部署。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for domain tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室最擅长的人才与算力上硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型，再通过后训练做出领域级表现。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure before post-training; synthetic data curated by domain experts replaces sensitive customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准是后训练之前的关键基础设施，开源可借社区反馈提升质量；在敏感领域，用专家把关的合成数据替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Early bets on custom models and post-training were a mistake; start with closed-source models to build a sticky product, and only post-train when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 早期押注自研模型与后训练是错误；应先用闭源模型做出有黏性的产品，直到推理成本逼迫时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data; continual learning from redlines turns partner edits into per-firm rubrics.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是做出最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自有数据定制；从合伙人红线批注中持续学习，把修改转化为各所专属的评分标准。

gabepereyra.en: Product focus shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; more lawyers, not fewer, as legal work grows more complex.
gabepereyra.zh: 产品重心从个人效率转向组织效率，协调人与智能体；随着法律工作更复杂，律师会更多而非更少。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化了对推理时算力扩展的认识，指出其收益递减；自博弈在零和博弈外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; models now know their limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠通用推理时算力扩展实现；模型开始知道自身局限。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，基准测试必须控制 token、成本或时间变量。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading and must be addressed.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，思维链监控正在退化，必须解决。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively, not as default workflow.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会增加时间成本，应选择性使用而非默认工作流。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 近期的对齐失败源于能力不足而非仅是根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Slowing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; six-month pauses cost little.
zvi.zh: 放缓前沿需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则；暂停六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment does not guarantee safety; misuse and power concentration set a lower bound on doom.
zvi.zh: 即使对齐被解决也不保证安全；滥用与权力集中为灾难概率设下下限。

zvi.en: AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; agent swarms may first act superhumanly, so pace actively.
zvi.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）到超级智能的间隔比想象更小；智能体集群可能最先展现超人表现，因此应主动控速。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time to beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）才是 AI 生产力的核心指标，而非单纯算力；晶圆级芯片通过减少权重搬运时间，在推理上比 GPU 快出数量级。

feldman.en: Bottlenecks shifted from chip logic to HBM, CoWoS packaging, power, cooling and data-center capacity, keeping supply constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 他把瓶颈从芯片逻辑本身转向 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、电力、散热与数据中心容量，并判断供给紧张至少持续五年——这是对早期“造出大芯片”叙事的深化。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 他明确判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已能在 TPU、Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定，云端切换只需八次击键。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; speed and open ecosystems will drive adoption.
feldman.zh: 他持续看好开源生态：开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5% 却便宜得多，速度与开放生态才是推动 AI 普及的关键，闭源的高价难以维系。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation, not incrementalism, wins.
feldman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%，必须掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 的全栈激进创新，渐进改良没有出路。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模，带来了十三四年的持续进步；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; low-precision custom chips and low data movement can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；低精度定制芯片与减少数据搬运可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock harder problems than chatbots.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统在分解任务上运行数小时到数周，配合上下文工程，将解决聊天机器人做不到的更难问题。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进来，而不只是被动的下一个词预测；数据并未耗尽。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via recursive self-improvement, plus co-designed hardware, is the next frontier.
jeffdean.zh: 通过递归自我改进自动化机器学习与科学方法，加上软硬件协同设计，是下一个前沿。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 聊天式界面仍是与智能体交互的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, automating tasks so you can live your life; designers move up the stack to taste and delight.
johnbai.zh: AI 应让人离开电脑、自动完成任务以回归生活；设计师应上移到品味与愉悦感层面。

johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a throwaway approach that encourages creativity.
johnbai.zh: AI 降低创造成本，支持快速原型与“可丢弃”式开发，从而激发创造力。

johnbai.en: Bots with specific use cases and simple building blocks connected by AI are powerful; delegate email and calendar to them.
johnbai.zh: 具备具体用例、由 AI 连接简单积木的机器人很强大；把邮件和日历交给它们。

johnbai.en: Designers should not fear AI; it frees them from mundane production work and unlocks inaccessible skills.
johnbai.zh: 设计师不应畏惧 AI；它把人从琐碎生产工作中解放，并解锁原本难以掌握的技能。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data and synthetic data are needed for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，通往 AGI 还需规划、搜索、多模态数据与合成数据。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
