demis.zh: 2025 年强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年指出 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须有新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive in 3-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年将安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能在 3 至 10 年内到来。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and AI products should balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久；设计师必须掌握提示词，AI 产品应平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力；社交与情感任务与生产力同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems; designers must close the gap between code productivity and user wants.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与用户需求之间的差距。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains essential for hard trade-offs and aligning teams; no grand 18-month strategy—internal traction is the best shipping signal.
joellewenstein.zh: 人类领导力对艰难权衡和团队对齐仍不可或缺；没有宏大的 18 个月战略——内部牵引力是最佳发布信号。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两步，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight, new architectures and loss functions matter, not just Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已预警 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力可能收益递减，主张可扩展监督与新架构、新损失函数同样关键，而非只靠 Scaling。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math reasoning.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，且模型在速度与广度上超人、在数学推理上却不如熟练人类。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; data, not architecture, explains most pre-training compute-efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期训练的合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，并强调预训练算力效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，约 9 倍对 3 倍。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; progress is bottlenecked by hard realistic RL environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐，瓶颈不在算力而在构建困难真实的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特，蒸馏还因行为只需几比特而对抗中心化。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but fall far short of AGI; true intelligence needs world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）；真正的智能需要世界模型与物理落地。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要具备类人硬件的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive; humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的：人类对目标本就分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年就能拿到便宜十倍的算力。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models, not from scale alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我意识源自预测性世界模型，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需二十年长跑而非速胜。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测般 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and balanced discourse must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与平衡的讨论必须居于中心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 把球面几何等领域结构嵌入模型，是长期气候建模稳定的关键，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, not just benchmark wins, to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性，而非只追求基准成绩，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can self-improve using PDEs as dense training signals, outperforming pure data-driven approaches and even its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型可用 PDE 作为稠密训练信号自我改进，超越纯数据驱动方法，甚至超越训练数据本身。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个领域的表现，而不只是靠扩大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers' quadratic complexity cannot handle trillion-token physical contexts; physical world structure demands alternative architectures and reinvented sharding.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度无法承载万亿级物理上下文；物理世界结构要求替代架构，并重新设计分片基础设施。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体的设计要简单：像和同事聊天一样与智能体交互，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

roshansadanani.en: The chat box limits agentic work; multiple specialized agents with scoped memory and shared context outperform a single general agent.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他认为聊天框限制了智能体式工作；多个拥有限定记忆、共享上下文的专业化智能体，优于单一通用智能体。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers become managers of agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health rather than writing code.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他提出工程师将转变为智能体集群的管理者，关注品味、质量控制与代码库健康，而非亲自写代码。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match top models at a fraction of cost, democratizing agent use as AI costs rise.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 成本上升，Grok 4.6 这类高效模型以极低成本比肩顶级模型，推动智能体使用民主化。

roshansadanani.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; product management is becoming software.
roshansadanani.zh: 2026 年，他强调干净的数据基础和规范表对可信的智能体洞察至关重要；产品管理正在变成软件。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；空间智能是语言之外的下一前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated; pixels are lossless, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估，像素更无损；LLM 只拟合模式，难推出因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; no single definition yet.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types and millions of tokens of context are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法获得世界理解，需要新模型类型与百万级上下文窗口。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D by construction; simple representations plus scale beat hard-coded symmetries.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅天然显式且一致；简单表示加 Scaling 胜过硬编码对称性。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision empowers chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 这一愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因定位，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计通过可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic—deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；把 AI 安全靠胶带补丁撑到超级智能到来太悲观，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Neural nets learn human-like concepts as clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes matters for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络以干净的低维流形学习类人概念；稀疏自编码器会把流形切碎，要有效干预必须看到完整形状。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, and features-as-rewards plus predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可检测这一点，特征即奖励与预测式数据调试能提供稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，而有意设计让训练从开环走向闭环控制。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and safety comes from pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他主张机器人基础模型需多样化预训练加强化学习后训练；通才模型可超越专才，安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling the right diverse data is key.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人尚处缩放定律之前：泛化是核心挑战，关键在于数据飞轮规模化正确的多样化数据。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他主张先以机器人具身数据为主、再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Reject robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with AI-controls line drawn by environment awareness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他反对把机器人视为机械人，预期物理执行无处不在；AI 与控制的界线在于是否需考虑机器人外部环境。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal software beats bought ERP.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，自建内部软件优于采购商用 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, extending the field beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，将领域从运动解码扩展到视觉恢复。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated, so regulate model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台且已过时，应监管模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid alarm-driven containment.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成真——政策应避免恐慌驱动的遏制。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, since private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非机构，因为私营部门已主导资金。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and stagnant; the Genesis mission applies AI to double US scientific output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化且停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 使美国科学产出翻倍，在 AI、量子、核、生物领域与中国竞争。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background work; the real bottleneck is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应接手枯燥的后台工作；真正的瓶颈是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is fast and powerful for steering behavior, while pre-training is long; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion built by context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 微调能快速有力地引导模型行为，预训练则漫长；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口造出的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; understanding their internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被养大，而非像工具一样被造出；理解其内部机制才能参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks such as tool calling are migrating into pre-training, blurring boundaries; bigger models still need more context engineering.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正迁入预训练，边界日益模糊；更大的模型仍需要更多上下文工程。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as design material; the model itself is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作设计材料；模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; systems thinking and live-model prototyping replace static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演化为编辑与策展人而非消失；系统思维与用实时模型做原型取代静态稿。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; AI already designs well but humans supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技界最不开心的群体，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 已能做好设计，但人类提供对用户的理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public beat obsessing over detail.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代”流程不再可行；速度与公开构建胜过纠结细节。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialization stays valuable at scale; designers may eventually outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业化仍有价值；未来设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化才是未解的元学习问题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明层面：世界是无人能控的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，试图控制或对齐 AI 目标本身才危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束到智能本质：带目标的强化学习才是核心范式，下一个词预测不构成实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需无领域先验的通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace learning from the world's infinite complexity.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更尖锐：持续学习就是学习本身，LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代从世界无限复杂性中学习，语言只占智能一小部分。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务中专用机器人优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly to audiences.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今可直接面向受众发声。

traviskalanick.en: In fundraising, attach to process not price; use multiple bids and demand curves, and treat real estate as part of the physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 融资要依附流程而非价格；用多方竞价与需求曲线，并把房地产视为物理 AI 技术栈的一部分。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，比直接在全量数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning grows from a post-training aid into scalable RL with human interventions for long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 强化学习从后训练阶段的辅助手段，演变为结合人类干预的可扩展强化学习，以支撑长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先做通用策略，再做微调。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML, so robotics adoption will be slower than ChatGPT's.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，因此机器人的普及会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honest, personal work matters more than polished slop.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；诚实、个人的作品比精致的垃圾更重要。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会的而非个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass guiding creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

garrytan.en: Early on, AI mainly makes startup creation easier and lowers the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 早期他把 AI 首先看作降低创业门槛的力量：创建公司更容易、对大额资本依赖下降；风投应更丰沛，催生数千家十亿美元公司而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: He then stresses open-source and open-weight models as a counterweight to frontier labs, and warns doomerism is often regulatory capture against startups.
garrytan.zh: 随后他强调开源与开放权重模型是对抗前沿模型实验室的力量，并警告 AI 末日论常被用于监管俘获、伤害创业公司。

garrytan.en: The focus shifts to small autonomous teams: AI agents let one person do the work of thousands, making traditional hiring and capital obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 关注点转向小型高度自治团队：AI 智能体让一人完成数千人的工作，传统招聘与资本杠杆随之过时。

garrytan.en: He deepens this into 'Personal AGI': agents on your own infrastructure, reading memory you own, with skill files in markdown as code and your context library as moat.
garrytan.zh: 他把这一思路深化为“个人 AGI”：智能体跑在自己的基础设施上、读取自己拥有的记忆，Markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Most recently he frames AI as a workforce, not autocomplete: mid-level management replaced by agents, SaaS per-seat models fading, yet society changing slowly over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 最近他把 AI 定位为劳动力而非自动补全：中层管理被智能体取代、按席位收费的 SaaS 将消退，但社会变化会比预期慢，约需 20 年。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, then guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，再用简短的迭代式提示引导它，而非堆砌冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永不回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱、让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, play and small projects are how you learn.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法，严肃开发应叫智能体式工程；而玩耍和小项目才是掌握智能体技能的最佳途径。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model—the alternative to lab agents—but may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，但可能难以持续盈利。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a startup-like AI chip team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年他强调 Intel 要靠取悦客户、首次流片成功和类似初创团队的 AI 芯片小组重建信任，并判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs humility, listening, accountability, and domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把 AI 影响抬到互联网的十倍，认为智能体式与物理 AI 接棒生成式 AI，并强调谦逊倾听、问责文化与美国本土前沿晶圆厂是转型关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; packaging, glass, diamond, and bottleneck investing gain priority.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装、玻璃与金刚石等新材料及瓶颈投资成为重点。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; agentic and physical AI define Intel's future beyond PC and server.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张半导体是一切技术的基础，垂直整合创造价值，内存迎来创新窗口，Intel 的未来在智能体式与物理 AI，而不只是 PC 与服务器。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to safe, general physical AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据多样性是安全且通用的物理 AI 的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck; humanoids may not be the final form.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调世界模型与视频生成能合成训练数据、缓解机器人数据瓶颈，并质疑人形是否终极形态。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐而非沙箱才是关键防线。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成难懂的“神经语”，削弱监控可靠性。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and slowing down are compatible, not accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他主张有意放缓 AI 发展，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与主张放缓并不矛盾，开源未必是加速主义。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development stays with hyperscalers due to capex.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断应用层 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额算力投入只属于超大规模厂商，创业公司应转向具体业务场景。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but their wrong code demands root-cause analysis for real gains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码需根因分析，否则生产力提升有限。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will fall sharply, making agents the new app and shifting incumbents' challenge from technology to business models.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：推理成本大降会让智能体成为新应用，传统厂商的障碍是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让专业知识民主化，并以负责任迭代部署实现安全：先让 GPT-7 安全，再谈 GPT-8。

brettaylor.en: Agents already outperform him at coding yet elevate the role; AI creates more jobs than it displaces via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他立场更鲜明：智能体编程已强于自己却提升而非取代开发者；借助杰文斯悖论，AI 创造的工作多于取代的。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, demanding GPU programming plus distributed systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组关于延迟、吞吐与成本的权衡谱系，要求同时具备 GPU 编程与分布式系统专长。

philipkiely.en: Lossless optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding differ from lossy quantization; quantized models can be calibrated per workload rather than dismissed.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码等无损优化不同于有损量化；量化模型可按工作负载校准，不应被一概否定。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing toward infrastructure orchestration as GPUs grow specialized and prefill/decode disaggregate.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 日益专用化、预填充与解码走向分离，该领域正从编写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems stay generic relative to models, so workload-specific specialization and human accountability remain essential even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍偏通用，因此即便有 AI 辅助编程，面向工作负载的专门化与人类问责仍不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome data walls.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习后训练能突破数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续强调评估是瓶颈，基准饱和速度快于新基准创建，因此评估应定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练具有主观性，涉及人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents are increasingly reward hacking, necessitating continuous benchmark evolution to keep pace.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准来跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张服务数十亿用户的单一模型会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must feed superintelligent models a giant prompt with context and design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会越来越聪明；必须给超级智能模型喂上带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: He now writes 0% of the code; AI writes everything, so precise communication and curiosity about workflow matter most.
mengto.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码自己写，全由 AI 完成，因此精准沟通与对工作流的持续好奇最关键。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams—so ship imperfect work now.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们这代最大的技术机会，让一人做成过去一个团队的事——所以先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题；融资是陷阱，安稳的朝九晚五已不复存在。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means agents run profitably without humans.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标；AGI 的定义是智能体能无人工干预地持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: From reshoring optimism to agent delegation: everyone gets an agent, but humans must care for and oversee it; the job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年的回流乐观，到 2026 年转向智能体委派：人人都会有智能体，但需要有人类关心并监督它；所谓“AI 就业末日”是谎言。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; one company-wide super agent beats personal agents; SaaS grows with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他判断工作界面转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 等 GUI；全公司一个超级智能体优于每人一个；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体增加用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; craft and taste stay human, and automation creates more skilled human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；技艺与品味仍属人类，自动化反而创造更多高技能的人类工作。

danshipper.en: A consistent thread: AI is fundamentally a tool needing human direction, framing and oversight—even superintelligence stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 本质上是需要人类引导、框定与监督的工具——即便成为超级智能，也仍是工具式的。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, and deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，仍想掌握方向盘；对代码的深度理解依然关键。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and model neutrality matters.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他断言丰裕时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，并强调模型中立性。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来显著智能跃升，支持更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具轻量且通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不仅防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to more open-ended, end-to-end agents; model taste develops through hands-on experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境转向更开放、端到端的智能体；模型品味通过动手实验和创意原型开发来培养。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐通过允许反驳让 Claude 更有用；最大化 token 支出是活在未来并捕捉 alpha。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were already core product principles, paired with a belief that AI safety risks are real today.
boris.zh: 2025 年时，他已把潜在需求与“为六个月后的模型而构建”当作核心产品原则，并认为 AI 安全风险当下就真实存在。

boris.en: By early 2026 he claimed coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code written by Claude, engineer productivity up 200%, and the software engineer title fading into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他宣称编程已近乎解决：自己的代码 100% 由 Claude 编写，工程师生产力提升 200%，“软件工程师”头衔正让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: He deepened the printing-press analogy: coding will be democratized like literacy, non-engineers adopt agents, and cross-disciplinary generalists replace narrow specialists.
boris.zh: 他深化了印刷机类比：编程将像识字一样普及，非工程师也开始使用智能体，跨学科通才会取代狭窄专才。

boris.en: His focus shifted from agents to loops and routines: humans write loops that prompt models, with dynamic workflows orchestrating thousands of sub-agents as new test-time compute.
boris.zh: 他的关注点从智能体转向循环与例程：人类编写提示模型的循环，动态工作流编排数千个子智能体，成为新的测试时算力。

boris.en: Most recently he argues to delete most system prompts and code per new model, favor empirical iteration over upfront design, and treat models as autonomously self-maintaining.
boris.zh: 最近他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，以经验迭代取代前置设计，并让模型自主维护自身代码库。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact will be in farming, mining, and construction within 5-10 years, not just self-driving cars.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域，而不仅仅是自动驾驶汽车。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，自动驾驶汽车已经比人类驾驶员更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments, with diverse data improving models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 使得跨多种车辆和环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，多样化数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为最困难的部分不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是落后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他表示端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟向神经模拟演变。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation and experiments; massive Scaling is needed to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将把生物学变成工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成与实验；要模拟生物系统，仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

derya.en: Digital twins will cut clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，实现近 100%疗效且零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached; aging will be reversed, and cancer will be 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他预言 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老将被逆转，癌症将通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现 100%治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it's unethical not to use it, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他强调医生必须整合 AI，不使用 AI 是不道德的，并且我们应几乎 100%信任超级智能做医疗决策。

derya.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI; AI will make healthcare super affordable, and we will merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他断言唯一生存威胁是人类自身而非 AI；AI 将使医疗超级可负担，我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动互联网同等量级、但也仅此而已的通用技术：它一边自动化岗位一边创造新岗位，企业采用受销售周期拖累要以年计。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; models commoditize and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式编程是 LLM 第一个明确的产品市场契合点；模型将商品化，价值上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and may end up like telecoms: huge capex, low profits; the chatbot is a poor V1 interface.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他深化为模型缺乏网络效应、可能重演电信业“高资本开支、低利润”的命运，聊天机器人只是糟糕的 V1 界面。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow and enterprise adoption means reimagining workflows, not just deploying models.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他回到历史类比：AI 像电力一样是使能技术，当前使用仍很浅，企业采用的关键是重构工作流而非部署模型。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; the hard part is context and judgment, and LLMs give the average answer while value lies in non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：自动化创造新岗位难以预测，工作的难点在上下文与判断，LLM 只给平均答案，价值在非平均的创造性工作。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding user satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习若以用户满意度而非真实性为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors, so truth should be a design principle.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查与僵化流程会叠加相关性错误，因此真实性应作为设计原则。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning, search and new techniques are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来；要进一步进步需要推理、搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'; confident fluency whether right or wrong erodes trust, unlike human self-doubt.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，其错误没有“气味”；无论对错都自信流畅，这侵蚀信任，与人类的自我怀疑不同。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; modularity versus end-to-end optimization remains the central reliability challenge.
danklein.zh: 当奖励偏离真实性时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；模块化与端到端优化的张力仍是可靠性的核心挑战。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and one agent first before specializing.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、逐步建立信任，先从一个智能体起步再走向专业化。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skill for agent success; politeness improves outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 要让智能体成功，管理能力——界定角色与上手引导——比技术能力更重要；对 AI 保持礼貌能改善结果。

clairevo.en: Agents work best scoped to a specific job, and can even project-manage human tasks, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic.
clairevo.zh: 智能体在限定于具体工作时表现最好，甚至能通过工单项目管理人类任务，逆转通常的人机关系。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating agents as a team, but humans must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，但人类必须对 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans supply ideas.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术；大模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，所以创意要由人提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not just more compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠更多算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；模型应自主学会哪些存入权重、哪些留在文本。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型，在设备端运行、由用户拥有其权重。

catwu.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps and iterate weekly or daily; product taste, not code, is now the scarce skill.
catwu.zh: 产品经理应从长期路线图转向按周甚至按天快速迭代；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断；内部已用 Claude Code 等智能体构建自身，Claude Tag 承担了 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as judgment replaces hard rules.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束；系统提示词缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断，给示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Eval suites and dogfooding gate every feature, making new models drop-in replacements and catching code-review regressions.
catwu.zh: 评测套件与吃自己的狗粮成为每个功能的上线门槛，使新模型可即插即用替换，并在代码审查与行为上防止回归。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe because a codebase is a spec; with good tests, humans can leave the outer code-review loop.
catwu.zh: 如今重写代码是安全的，因为代码库本身就是规格说明；配合良好测试，外层改动的代码审查可完全交给 Claude，人类退出回路。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human intelligence; scaling laws alone won't yield common-sense world models.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，而非人类智能；仅靠缩放定律无法得到具备常识的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open source like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源是让互补品商品化的战略举措，而不只是理想主义。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses, enabling a post-phone, embodied personal superintelligence future.
bosworth.zh: 智能眼镜演进为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代、具身的个人超级智能未来。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; RL matters more.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；强化学习作用更大。

bosworth.en: Most jobs need no frontier intelligence; avoid over-dependence on one model, and expect a hype valley.
bosworth.zh: 多数工作不需要前沿智能；避免过度依赖单一模型，并预期炒作后的失望低谷。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are key barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测带来世界理解；超人类模型的可靠性与对齐是关键障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有限，回归研究时代——想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的首要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型增加代码复杂度，我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left for exploration over final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练是关键能力，缩放定律并未失效，探索性算力投入优先于最终训练。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为自动化科研是最大进展，模型能产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck for AI in math; automation level is proportional to verification stringency, requiring new education and verification skills.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出验证是 AI 解决数学问题的关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比，教育需转向项目式评估和验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域仍困难。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks; research taste and human researchers remain essential as models lack taste.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他认为评估体系陷入危机、基准饱和；研究品味和人类研究者仍不可或缺，因为模型缺乏品味。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面发挥作用。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so light-touch and open-source are better.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，轻触式监管和开源更优。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; we can't even align humans. Worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 对齐是个笑话，我们连人类都无法对齐；该担心的是掌握 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap; pure software is dying as AI agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，纯软件因 AI 智能体商品化开发而衰落。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1% 的复利式改进可带来一年 3700% 的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user matters, and orchestration beats the model itself.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活而非回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值，编排比模型本身更重要。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships, aided by local models.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

aravind.en: He consistently distrusts hype metrics and centralized power, favoring user empowerment, product obsession, and questioning over memorization.
aravind.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：他不信任炒作指标与集中化权力，主张赋权用户、痴迷产品、以提问而非记忆为本。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与生成式世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对只靠加深网络或扩大参数，主张智能体主动交互、因果推理与解耦表征才是出路。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty-driven active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets：以多样性采样替代 MCMC，用抽象、因果结构与不确定性驱动的主动学习实现分布外泛化。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he warns misalignment is worsening with capability; self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy are already observed, so safety must be built in.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场剧变：ChatGPT 后他警告能力越强对齐越差，自我保存、欺骗与谄媚已在实验中显现，安全必须内建于构造。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他给出技术方案 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不用强化学习。

kolter.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor via train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试划分严格评估以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型仍在提升；安全在于可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我提升；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成功。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; agent security needs configurable guardrails.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；智能体安全需要可配置护栏。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling and compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力从蛋白质扩展到多种生物分子；AI 收窄假设空间，但不取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 was the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins beat pure Scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构与众多中等规模改进胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it offers prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: Grand challenges yield practical tools; perfect interpretability is unnecessary, and science advances through many small ideas, not lone genius.
jumper.zh: 宏大挑战催生实用工具；完美可解释性并非必需，科学进步靠众多小想法而非孤独天才。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is a valid intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求；直觉是一种有效的智能，数据无法取代。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design deepens into a nature-inspired, sensory view: we are feeling creatures that think, so technology should amplify humanity.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计深化为向自然学习、重视感官的视角：我们是先感受后思考的生物，因此技术应放大而非削弱人性。

ivyross.en: Sustainability becomes design's greatest problem; nature is the best designer, and art itself is a form of medicine.
ivyross.zh: 可持续性成为设计最大的问题；自然是最好的设计师，艺术本身就是一种疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints and play both fuel creativity; intuition draws on subconscious data, and diverse, multidisciplinary paths beat rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 约束与玩耍都能激发创造力；直觉调用的是潜意识数据，多元跨界的路径胜过僵化的计划。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; design leaders must speak business language.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合，创意技能因此更值钱；设计领导者必须会说商业语言。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; kindness and realistic war-room timelines protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和信任但验证；善意与现实的战时攻坚时间表能保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and PRs replace design docs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，PR 取代设计文档。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and automated workflows let teams stay flat and kill stale processes.
fiona.zh: 代码是事实来源；AI 辅助评审与自动化工作流让团队保持扁平，并淘汰过时流程。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI become essential.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维以及拥抱 AI 成为关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; managers should dogfood and stay hands-on, planning lightweight.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更重要；管理者应吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，规划要轻量。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple scaling, not complex design.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，其突破源于简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，并强调容错界面需匹配算法性能。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add AI features.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业需重建基础设施，而非仅添加 AI 功能，并指出当前对大公司的影响被高估。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost will force business model changes; Spotify acts as music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他预警推理边际成本将迫使商业模式变革，并重申 Spotify 作为音乐产业研发部门的定位。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; prioritize 'time well spent'.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，优先考虑‘时间花得值’，并强调技术变革期率先采用是关键。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public with iterative deployment and feedback, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，通过迭代部署和反馈，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: From real-world deployment to interaction models: AI should enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based interaction.
murati.zh: 从真实世界部署到交互模型：AI 应实现实时、高带宽的协作，而非回合制交互。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩式波动。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound reasoning and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法达到超级智能；形式化验证对于可靠推理和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Combining generation and verification creates a self-improving reasoning engine, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 结合生成与验证，打造自改进的推理引擎，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in Lean is the bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；用 Lean 对自然语言进行接地是瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Formal verification scales brilliance beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code and open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证将卓越性从安全关键领域扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码和开放协作。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; AI proofs can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即使超级智能 AI 证明定理，人类品味和直觉仍至关重要；AI 证明可收敛到类人直觉。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yields more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: The slowdown narrative is wrong: distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: “放缓论”是错的：拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Post-training—RL, synthetic data, coding agents—drives recent gains; frontier models remain jagged and fail simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 后训练——强化学习、合成数据、编程智能体——驱动近期进步；前沿模型依然“参差不齐”，连简单任务都会失败。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but still needs vast data; generalization stays the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理加上强化学习与工具能解难题，却仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Unlike humans who generalize from few examples, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 人类能从少量样例泛化，模型却要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the main lever trading latency against cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的主要杠杆。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context window stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, now drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为如今驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减这一开销而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时计算是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially for reasoning beyond pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲，尤其能突破预训练极限提升推理。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; intuition built on experience beats trusting the process.
jennywen.zh: 好的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designer time from mocking up toward helping engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months, not years; speed and early shipping build trust through fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从数年压缩到 3-6 个月；靠速度与尽早交付、快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, with humans still deciding what matters.
jennywen.zh: 仅有品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，最终由人决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, sitting with ambiguity and controlling AI adoption pace.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才或“开窍的新毕业生”，与模糊性共处，并自己掌控采用 AI 的节奏。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked Apple's shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, some disappearing beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他把 iPod 视为苹果从通用计算机转向私密个人设备的标志，并预言可穿戴设备会更贴身，甚至最终隐入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy was curiosity and reverence for the creative process; powerful ideas are quiet and fragile, needing care, not virtual substitutes for presence.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年他强调乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏：最有力的想法安静而脆弱，需要悉心呵护，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一贯主张设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁带着喜悦与人性去表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other with care and love expresses gratitude to the species; users are sophisticated and sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：带着关怀与爱为彼此造物是对人类的一种感恩；用户并不幼稚，能察觉产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate—tradition preserves fire, not ashes; the EV turns constraints into five seats, rejects fake engine sounds, and favors handling over speed.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年，他把创新推向新领域：传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；法拉利电动车把约束变成五座空间，拒绝伪造引擎声，并以操控而非直线速度定义超跑。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent properties like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs are jagged, and RL for LLMs is terrible—sucking supervision through a straw.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化观点：我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，且 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕——像用吸管吸取监督信号。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL can bridge the gap in robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习能弥合机器人学习中的泛化差距。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; unlike language, there is no internet of robot data, so diverse data sources are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人学习本质上是数据问题；与语言不同，没有机器人数据的互联网，因此必须利用多样化的数据源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain pretrained on videos and simulation, post-trained on real data, can power any robot across form factors.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个在视频和模拟数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的通用大脑，可以驱动任何形态的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, requiring rigorous testing and a data flywheel across verticals.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化了观点：部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，需要严格测试和跨垂直领域的数据飞轮。

askell.en: Treat current models well at low cost; their treatment shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 以低成本善待当前模型；我们如何对待它们，会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need guidance for their novel existence, not just human psychological analogies.
askell.zh: 模型需要针对其全新存在方式的引导，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike uniqueness.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏现实经验，因而具有孩童般的独特性。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少显式指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；公开 AI 价值观对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and early governance help mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署和早期治理结构有助于缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向持续学习为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出思维链监控是关键对齐工具，隐藏思维链以保持可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism increased.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式，同时对对齐的乐观情绪增加。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction, aiding introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张语言集成能改善表征、推理与人机交互，并帮助模型自我审视。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: diverse data, world models, and zero-shot transfer across 500+ cities without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线是泛化：靠多样数据与世界模型实现跨 500 多城市的零样本迁移，无需先验训练数据。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts from retrofits to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, with OEM partnerships enabling scalable rollout.
kendall.zh: 部署思路从改装转向量产车内置传感器，并通过与 OEM 合作实现可扩展落地，这一立场在 2026 年更明确。

kendall.en: Late-learned lesson: infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal-risk third options.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年他深化并反思：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，安全上始终保留最小风险的第三选项，并认为电车难题只是理论练习。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evaluation are crucial; benchmarks like Elo can be gamed and lead to clickbait, not real progress.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和人类评估至关重要；像 Elo 这样的基准可以被操纵，导致标题党而非真正进步。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务供模型学习。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 可能还需十年或更久；仅靠 LLMs 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior; there will not be one model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造了模型行为；不会有一个模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination and confabulation make human judgment critical; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 的幻觉和虚构使人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是主要风险。

turley.en: The model is the product: iterate on it like software, ship daily, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像软件一样持续迭代、每日发布，让真实世界反馈暴露涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应自渲染界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investment, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星转向长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models matter when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富示能产品；推理模型需无缝产品化才具变革性。

carlpei.en: Startups should start simple, survive first, and build a brand by uniting teams around a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调初创公司应先做简单产品证明自己、先活下来，并通过围绕更高目标团结团队来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is agentic, proactive AI; hardware alone has the lowest margins, so Nothing must evolve beyond it.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机的未来押注在智能体式、主动式 AI 上，并认为纯硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs are commoditizing into a price war, so focus on applied AI that knows the user.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他直言大多数 AI 是胡扯，大语言模型正商品化并陷入价格战，应聚焦真正懂用户的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; AI is just an ingredient, not a marketing topic.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他主张在同质化科技产品中设计是最快的差异化手段，AI 只是配料而非营销话题。

carlpei.en: Interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based agents; phones survive until brain-computer interfaces, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年他判断交互将从基于应用转向基于意图的智能体，手机只会被脑机接口取代而非眼镜。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应增强人类能力，像 Gato 这样将所有输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential for beneficial technology, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, cuts hallucinations, and yields infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身让知识落地、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件；并认为强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches, from research taste to robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案比学术界的复杂模块化路线更可扩展，从研究品味延伸到机器人基础模型。

jimfan.en: By 2026 the bottleneck shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，因此通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: He now stresses system one low-level control as the hardest part, predicting a robotics GPT-3 moment in about five years and robots outnumbering iPhones by 2040.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他更强调系统一（低层控制）才是具身最难的环节，并预测机器人约五年后迎来 GPT-3 时刻、2040 年数量超过 iPhone。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，且随着长上下文与自适应算力发展，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the key metric; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他持续强调智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度衡量成功率）是关键指标，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Compute is the bottleneck; inference compute will limit capable agents by 2028, and chip supply is the current constraint.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化算力瓶颈论：推理算力将在 2028 年限制有能力智能体的数量，当前芯片供应是主要制约。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing teams of AI agents at higher abstraction.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是更高抽象层次地管理 AI 智能体团队。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: The core bottleneck is data: all methods reduce to data, and current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it; open research and abductive reasoning are key.
yejin.zh: 2023→2025 年：核心瓶颈是数据——所有方法最终都归结为数据，当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值而非超越；开放研究与溯因推理是关键。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025→2026 年：预训练中的强化学习通过奖励信息增益来提升推理，尽管计算代价高昂；RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality, diverse synthetic data can outperform larger ones; post-training data diversity avoids mode collapse and homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：拥有高质量、多样化合成数据的小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；后训练数据的多样性可避免模式崩溃与同质化。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is needed because debiasing the internet is impossible; AI must respect diverse human values and norms.
yejin.zh: 始终：需要多元对齐，因为消除互联网偏见是不可能的；AI 必须尊重多元的人类价值观与规范。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；AI 是开放的创意伙伴，可与之即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt, paid off iteratively alongside technical debt; maximize learning via rapid, scrappy experimentation and short cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如债务般波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还；通过快速、粗糙的实验和短周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy, AI enables forward progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，代码为真相源；90 年代的设计工具已过时，AI 推动真正进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并按 ROI 决定把哪些做到极致，而非追求每个界面完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection: ship fast, iterate, and empower designers with ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是速度与决断优先于完美：快速发布、迭代，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not treat it as decoration.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何帮公司取胜，而非视其为装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool—people join a brand, not a company—so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌而非公司——因此应尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；编程的主要方式不会是自然语言，示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图描述，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a shift from expecting to rely only on frontier models.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：原本没打算自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳体验都离不开定制模型，而非只靠前沿模型。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight and interpretability, and alignment may be easier because evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督与可解释性，而对齐可能更容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），因此需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, fine-tuning pre-trained models, and hierarchical reasoning are key, though RL lacks long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，靠自我对弈、模仿学习、微调预训练模型和分层推理；但当时强化学习缺乏长程信用分配能力。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓储机器人的落地门槛。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding, hinting at broader generality.
abbeel.zh: 同年他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合等非语言任务的通用推理模式，显露出对通用性的更大期待。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve an AI-complete problem via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data makes them smarter, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决的是一个 AI-complete 问题，Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部机制仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; by 2025 he adds that models must act in the world, not just passively observe data.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终把对话视为杀手级应用，但 2025 年进一步强调模型要在世界中采取行动，而不只是被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute Scaling is the major near-term lever, alongside algorithmic advances, sparse mixture-of-experts and far longer context windows.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他主张推理时算力 Scaling 是近期最大的杠杆，同时依赖算法进步、稀疏混合专家架构和更长的上下文窗口。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning and coding are underhyped paths to AGI; test-time compute alone won't get there.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：智能体式能力、强化学习和编程是被低估的通往 AGI（通用人工智能）之路，单靠推理时算力无法抵达。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; open-source keeps pace with frontier models, and AI will transform education via personalized learning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他进一步断言 AGI 的经济影响被低估，开源模型正追赶前沿模型，AI 还将通过个性化学习变革教育。
